title: As NSE, Reliance Jio eye listings, what are India's biggest share offerings?
text: As NSE, Reliance Jio eye listings, what are India's biggest share offerings?. The offer-for-sale, which does not include any fresh capital being raised, ‌will value NSE at close to $46 billion, which would make ​it the country’s third-largest IPO.
